meta.title: Build on Frankencoin: contracts, API, indexer and MCP server
meta.description: Everything you need to integrate ZCHF and FCS: verified contracts on eight chains, a public REST API, a Ponder indexer, an MCP server and grants.

hero.title: A programmable Swiss franc.
hero.subtitle: Open source, audited, permissionless. Read balances with one call, mint against collateral with one transaction, index everything with one repo.
